name: odoo-semantic-mcp
description: MCP server connection for Odoo Semantic - semantic code intelligence (inheritance chains, field impact, model inspect, ORM validation) over HTTP. Fill the server URL and key in the plugin's configuration dialog; /odoo-semantic-mcp:connect guides and verifies.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Odoo Semantic API key (starts with osm_). Get one from your server admin or https://odoo-semantic.viindoo.com/install/. Fill it here (/plugin > odoo-semantic-mcp > Configure) or with `claude plugin configure`; /odoo-semantic-mcp:connect verifies the connection.

mcp_url.title: MCP Server URL
mcp_url.description: Base URL of your Odoo Semantic MCP server
